name: Business License
description: ﹢25% Golden Gift yield.

name: Paycheck
description: Gain ﹢40 (﹢10 per beaconed player) Golden Gifts every round if half or more of the players survive.

name: Tria Orbs
description: Makes Orbs appear around the map, Orbs boost you after jumping out of them.

name: Medal
description: If the level is odd, on collapse, the Medal spawns, bring it to the beacon for Golden Gifts and if the next level is an intermission, get the option to pick a difficult curse for Golden Gifts. Carrying it gives an extra double jump but disables abilities.

name: Grace Wings
description: Greatly enhances air control.

name: Grapple Points

name: Pocket Bell
description: An extra double jump.

name: Radar Module: Enemies
description: Tracks enemies through walls.

description: 25% Increased maximum jump height. Controllable jump height. Hold space to jump higher, tap space to jump lightly.

name: Ice Skates
description: Less slipping on ice. Going in one direction for a while slowly gives a speed boost.

name: Fanny Pack
description: During collapse, some tiles turn yellow. Collecting all gifts from these tiles gives bonus Golden Gifts.

name: Helmet
description: Bonking sends you upwards and allows full control.

name: More Altars
description: Spawns an extra altar.

name: Ninja Belt
description: Gives the player a unique buff according to their class.

name: Larger Grapple Points
description: Grapple Points are 25% larger.

name: Shark Tail
description: Gives the player a unique buff according to their class.

name: Gift Magnet

description: Instant Acceleration. Completely Removes the slippery/icey movement.

name: Sport Shoes
description: ﹢40% Movement speed.

name: Shield

name: Radar Module: Instruments
description: Marks the location of Cadence's instruments every 12 seconds and gives you an arrow pointing towards instruments.

name: Panic Necklace
description: When your last shield breaks, gain debuff immunity, movement speed and ﹢2 pickup range for 40 seconds.

name: Miniature Hourglass
description: Gives the player a unique buff according to their class.

name: Gift Idol
description: Collecting gifts has a ﹢1% chance to collect nearby gifts.

name: Drowned Ægis
description: Altar of Protection also gives a one time Void shield that teleports you out of the Void.

name: Adrenaline
description: ﹢20% Movement speed.

name: Defuse Kit
description: ﹢20% Chance for Tripmines to not explode. (Max 60%)

name: Final Stand
description: Gain a movement speed boost, 4 seconds of invincibility, and a shield when you are the last one alive.

name: Radar Module: Tripmines

name: Subspacial Barrier
description: Allows you take an extra hit from Tripmines and Void Implosions.

name: Birthday Pony
description: Springer collects gifts it lands on.

name: Star Marts
description: Star Marts can now spawn in the level. Touching a Star Mart will give movement speed, ﹢2 gift collection range and debuff immunity for 25 seconds.

name: Aggro Magnet
description: Increases the gift collection range by ﹢0.1 studs for every enemy targeting you.

name: Debuff Magnet

name: Jet Boosters
description: Double jumps redirect momentum towards where you're going.

name: Propeller Hat

name: Shadow Cloak
description: Lets you phase through players, small tile decorations and mid-air Springers.

name: Soul Tracers
description: Whenever a player dies, they drop an orb and increase the Golden Gift yield, collecting the orb further increases the Golden Gift yield.

name: Spring Shoes
description: 1.4x jump height while quick turning or standing still.

name: Altar Boons
description: Paycheck's reward increases by ﹢20% for each Altar used during the level.

name: Health Insurance
description: Paycheck always triggers.

name: Fleeting Fate
description: Upon entering collapse, gain ﹢40% movement speed, increased gift collection range and debuff immunity for 40 seconds.

name: Magnified Levels
description: Makes levels smaller.

name: Transient Pennon
description: ﹢1.5 seconds of flight.

name: Quixotic Wing
description: ﹢1.5 seconds of flight.
